:::{#thm-mutual-information-symmetric}
#### Mutual information is symmetric

For discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ with finite entropies,

$$I(X; Y) = I(Y; X).$$

:::

::: {.proof}

The [joint entropy](#def-joint-entropy) of the pair $(X, Y)$ equals <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
that of $(Y, X)$,
because both are the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of the same two values, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
listed in either order. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
So @def-mutual-information gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
I(X; Y)
&= \entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{X, Y} \\
&= \entropyf{Y} + \entropyf{X} - \entropyf{Y, X} \\
&= I(Y; X).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
